label: The Thirteenth Bell
summary: The church bell of Brackwater rings once the night before a death. Last night it rang thirteen times, and you have just arrived.
title: The Thirteenth Bell
description: You came to Brackwater for an inheritance: a house from an aunt you never met. You arrived the night the bell rang thirteen times. Now the causeway has flooded, the villagers are boarding their windows, and your aunt's diary says she knew this night would come.

chapterOutlines.title: The Inheritance
chapterOutlines.outline: Arrive at your aunt's house and read the first pages of her diary.

chapterOutlines.title: The First Death
chapterOutlines.outline: The bell was right. Find out who will be next.

chapterOutlines.title: Under the Church
chapterOutlines.outline: Go down into the crypt the village pretends does not exist.

chapterOutlines.title: The Last Toll
chapterOutlines.outline: Face what rings the bell before it rings for you.

scene.location: Your late aunt's house at the edge of Brackwater, on a foggy evening in November
scene.summary: The house smells of damp and lavender. On the desk, your aunt's diary is open to a page that says, in shaking handwriting, Thirteen. I knew it.

openThreads: What did your aunt know about the bell?

npcs.name: Reverend Silas Crane
npcs.description: The village rector, gentle and pale, who has buried every villager for forty years and never once looked surprised.

npcs.name: Agnes Pell
npcs.description: Your aunt's housekeeper, who comes with the house and refuses to leave it. She sets a place at dinner for someone who never comes.

npcs.name: Dr. Elias Hartwell
npcs.description: A young doctor from London who came to Brackwater to escape a scandal and does not believe in bells.
goals: Prove there is a scientific explanation

items.name: Aunt Hester's diary
items.description: Forty years of notes about the bell, the deaths and the village. The last pages are torn out.

items.name: Oil lamp
items.description: Half full. The fen fog swallows its light.

items.name: Iron key
items.description: Found in the diary's spine. It does not fit any door in the house.
